security_implications: This chunk contains the SBA bus lifecycle gate (u_tlul_lc_gate_sba) controlled by lc_hw_debug_en_gated[LcEnSba], which can block TL-UL transactions based on life cycle state. If this gate is misconfigured or bypassed (e.g., due to a timing glitch or incorrect state), an attacker could perform memory accesses in non-debug life cycle states, compromising system security. The integrity error host_r_other_err from the SBA adapter is explicitly not connected to an alert, relying on the life cycle to prevent its activation; a fault that triggers this error while the gate is open (or due to a gate failure) would be recorded only in a CSR, potentially letting data corruption or tampering go undetected.
